title: CREDA Governance Request Reference Schema
description: Non-normative public reference interface for submitting a governance request to a CREDA implementation.

request_id.description: Unique identifier for the governance request.

action.description: Implementation-defined identifier for the proposed action.

subject_id.description: Identifier for the subject, actor, agent, or system associated with the proposed action.

resource_id.description: Optional identifier for the resource or target affected by the proposed action.

scope.description: Optional implementation-defined scope associated with the request.

authority_state_reference.description: Optional reference to authority-related state relevant to the proposed action.

governance_context_reference.description: Optional reference to the governance or evaluation context applicable to the request.

requested_at.description: Timestamp at which the governance request was created.

metadata.description: Optional implementation-specific metadata. Consumers should not treat metadata as normative governance semantics.
